question: Manipuri Raas Leela, a renowned form of classical dance, was created by:
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Maharaja Bhagyachandra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Manipuri Raas Leela** is a highly revered classical dance form of **Manipur**, an Indian state in the northeastern region of the country.
 
• This dance form is deeply rooted in **Vaishnavism**, a tradition of devotion to **Lord Krishna**.
 
• **Maharaja Bhagyachandra**, a ruler of Manipur in the 18th century, is credited with conceptualizing and establishing the **Manipuri Raas Leela**.
 
• He was a devout follower of **Vaishnavism**, and under his reign, Manipuri Raas Leela was developed as a form of **spiritual expression** and to propagate the values of devotion and love for **Lord Krishna and Radha**.
 
• The dance combines **graceful movements, intricate footwork, and emotive expressions** to portray episodes from the life of **Lord Krishna**, particularly his love for **Radha**.
 
• Manipuri Raas Leela is performed during auspicious occasions such as **Janmashtami** and other festivals related to Lord Krishna.
 
• The costumes and music used in the dance reflect the **traditional culture of Manipur**. The female performers wear the iconic **Potloi** (a cylindrical skirt) while narrating the divine love story of Radha and Krishna.
 
• This dance form is characterized by its unique style of gentle and flowing movements, setting it apart from other Indian classical dance forms.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Birju Maharaj**__

 __
 
• **Birju Maharaj** was a legendary exponent of **Kathak**, another classical Indian dance form.
 
• He was born in **Lucknow** and belonged to the **Kalka-Bindadin Gharana** of Kathak.
 
• He is known for his contribution to popularizing Kathak both in India and globally, but he is not associated with the creation of **Manipuri Raas Leela**.
 
 
 
• **Siddhendra Yogi**__
 __
 
• **Siddhendra Yogi** is considered to be the founder of the **Kuchipudi** dance form, which originated in **Andhra Pradesh**.
 
• He played a crucial role in structuring Kuchipudi as a classical dance form with a strong connection to religious and mythological themes.
 
 
 
• **Sage Bharata**__
 
 
• **Sage Bharata** is traditionally known as the author of the **Natyashastra**, an ancient Indian treatise on performing arts, including dance, drama, and music.
 
• The Natyashastra provides the foundational principles for various Indian classical dance forms but does not directly involve the creation of **Manipuri Raas Leela**.
